description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing bank transfer payment extension in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying the configuration form ('index') and saving settings ('save'), with dependencies on models for language, order status, geo zones, and settings, as well as associated view rendering.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Controller class for managing bank transfer payment extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration form for the bank transfer payment method, including breadcrumbs, language strings, order statuses, geo zones, and other settings, then renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of configuration settings for the bank transfer payment method, including permission checks, validating input, and updating the settings.
